test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_filter_uniform ( id UInt64, arr_uint Array(UInt64), arr_str Array(String), keep_all Array(UInt8), keep_none Array(UInt8), keep_half Array(UInt8), keep_all_str Array(UInt8), keep_none_str Array(UInt8), keep_half_str Array(UInt8) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_filter_uniform SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> number + x, range(32)), arrayMap(x -> concat(toString(number + x), repeat('x', 64)), range(16)), arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(1), range(32)), arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(0), range(32)), arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(x % 2), range(32)), arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(1), range(16)), arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(0), range(16)), arrayMap(x -> toUInt8(x % 2), range(16)) FROM numbers(200000)
